text.aria-label: Subtitle text 'Mean net power in each month, as a share of effective capacity (axis title: the site). Night: 00:00 to 04:59; evening: 17:00 to 20:59; midday: 11:00 to 14:59, split into April to September (summer) and October to March (winter). Grey: March 2020 to June 2021, and October 2022. Dashed line: the first usable date after the early-calibration cut.'
text.tspan: Mean net power in each month, as a share of effective capacity (axis title: the site). Night:
00:00 to 04:59; evening: 17:00 to 20:59; midday: 11:00 to 14:59, split into April to September
(summer) and October to March (winter). Grey: March 2020 to June 2021, and October 2022. Dashed
line: the first usable date after the early-calibration cut.
